text:
sally_sec: heads-up — I found S3 object metadata on a few staging DB snapshots that include the full CMK ARN. leaking ARNs in object metadata is risky (exposes key identifiers to anyone who can list objects).

ben_engops: whoa, do you mean x-amz-meta headers?

sally_sec: yep. example HEAD output from the uploader bucket: 
```
x-amz-meta-cmk-arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
x-amz-meta-tenant: tenant-42
```
not super long but shows account+key id.

danya_db: how did that get into metadata? our backup code only sets tenant id + snapshot id.

mike_dev: uploader service includes an optional envelope helper that annotates objects with cmk info for easier restore mapping. we added it ~Q3 last year to debug cross-account restores and forgot to remove it.

raj_oncall: any active risk? is metadata exposed to prod lists?

sally_sec: staging only observed so far but bucket lifecycle/rules change could replicate pattern. also logs and S3 inventory CSVs would capture it. I'd treat it as sensitive enough to redact.

ben_engops: quick triage plan: 1) add detection query to the audit logs + S3 inventory for any x-amz-meta-cmk* 2) patch uploader to stop writing full ARN and only write an opaque alias id (or better, nothing) 3) add RBAC so only backup-service-role can head/get object metadata 4) plan metadata redaction for existing objects (rewrite head without those keys)

mike_dev: agree. small nuance: we still need a mapping to know which CMK to use for restores across accounts. maybe store KMS key alias in a secrets table keyed by snapshot id instead of object metadata.

danya_db: for restores we already have a restore_manifest stored in an encrypted DB row that maps snapshot ID -> kms-key-alias. we can migrate uploader to read that and stop writing key info to S3.

sally_sec: nice. for rollout: immediate firewall — push uploader change to stop writing new metadata; next, create a migration job to rewrite current objects without the header; finally, update RBAC and add monitoring.

raj_oncall: I'm +1 to an on-call runbook entry: if an alert fires for unexpected cmk metadata, block public/list permissions on bucket and engage sec & eng-ops.

ben_engops: implementable checklist I can take: 
- PR to uploader: remove cmk ARN header (owner: mike_dev)
- Add feature flag to enable safe rollback (owner: mike_dev)
- Audit queries (CloudTrail + S3 Inventory) for x-amz-meta-cmk* (owner: ben_engops)
- Migration job to rewrite objects and copy w/o metadata (owner: ben_engops)
- IAM tighten: ensure only backup-service-role can GetObjectTagging/HeadObject for backup buckets (owner: danya_db)
- Update runbook / incident playbook (owner: sally_sec)

mike_dev: I can open the PR this afternoon. patch is two lines in uploader: drop header write and add feature flag. will add tests.

sally_sec: good. also propose we rotate the alias-to-key mapping for any keys that we think may be at risk and log rotation in the KMS audit. not full rekeying, just alias rotation + revoke previous grant for external users.

danya_db: rekeying impacts long-running restores. we should coordinate with customers using Dedicated. schedule with a maintenance window if needed.

raj_oncall: I'll add an alert rule: if inventory shows >0 objects with x-amz-meta-cmk-arn in prod buckets, page sec-oncall and eng-ops immediately.

ben_engops: one more: add a CI lint check on the uploader repo that prevents committing code which writes headers matching /^x-amz-meta-cmk/ — prevents regressions.

mike_dev: ack, will include lint.

sally_sec: thanks all. I'll draft a short slack update to product and compliance summarizing: discovery, mitigation timeline, and customer-impact (none expected).

ben_engops: timeline estimate?

mike_dev: PR today, deploy to staging tonight, prod rollout tomorrow morning behind flag, migration job next week (low throttle).

sally_sec: perfect. tagging folks: @ben_engops @mike_dev @danya_db @raj_oncall — I'll open the incident ticket and link the PRs. :thumbsup:

uploader-bot: deploy pipeline started for uploader-service (build-3821)

raj_oncall: noted. I'll monitor alerts through the night.

sally_sec: closing loop here after deploy + migration complete. will post final status in #eng-security.
